business_owner_all.name: business_owner_all
business_owner_all.using: "business"."owner_id" in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid()))
business_owner_all.withCheck: "business"."owner_id" in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid()))

contract_landlord_all.name: contract_landlord_all
contract_landlord_all.using: "contract"."resident_id" in (select r.id from public.resident r where r.business_id in (select b.id from public.business b where b.owner_id in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid()))))
contract_landlord_all.withCheck:
"contract"."resident_id" in (select r.id from public.resident r where r.business_id in (select b.id from public.business b where b.owner_id in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid())))) and exists (
        select 1 from public.unit u join public.floor f on f.id = u.floor_id join public.property p on p.id = f.property_id
        where u.id = "contract"."unit_id" and p.business_id in (select b.id from public.business b where b.owner_id in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid()))))

contract_select_own.name: contract_select_own
contract_select_own.using: "contract"."resident_id" in (select r.id from public.resident r where r.person_id in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid())))

contract_template_landlord_all.withCheck: "contract_template"."business_id" in (select b.id from public.business b where b.owner_id in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid())))

document_insert_own.name: document_insert_own
document_insert_own.withCheck:
"document"."resident_id" in (select r.id from public.resident r where r.person_id in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid()))) and "document"."uploaded_by" in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid()))
        and "document"."status" = 'in_review' and "document"."reviewed_by" is null

document_requirement_select_as_resident.name: document_requirement_select_as_resident
document_requirement_select_as_resident.using:
"document_requirement"."required" and "document_requirement"."active"
        and "document_requirement"."business_id" in (select r.business_id from public.resident r where r.person_id in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid())))

document_requirement_exemption_landlord_.name: document_requirement_exemption_landlord_all
document_requirement_exemption_landlord_.using: "document_requirement_exemption"."resident_id" in (select r.id from public.resident r where r.business_id in (select b.id from public.business b where b.owner_id in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid()))))
document_requirement_exemption_landlord_.withCheck:
"document_requirement_exemption"."resident_id" in (select r.id from public.resident r where r.business_id in (select b.id from public.business b where b.owner_id in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid())))) and exists (
        select 1 from public.document_requirement q join public.resident r on r.business_id = q.business_id
        where q.id = "document_requirement_exemption"."requirement_id" and r.id = "document_requirement_exemption"."resident_id")

unit_owner_all.name: unit_owner_all
unit_owner_all.using:
exists (select 1 from public.floor f join public.property p on p.id = f.property_id
        where f.id = "unit"."floor_id" and p.business_id in (select b.id from public.business b where b.owner_id in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid()))))
unit_owner_all.withCheck:
exists (select 1 from public.floor f join public.property p on p.id = f.property_id
        where f.id = "unit"."floor_id" and p.business_id in (select b.id from public.business b where b.owner_id in (select id from public.person where user_id = (select auth.uid()))))

unit_apartment_fields.name: unit_apartment_fields
unit_apartment_fields.value:
("unit"."type" = 'apartment' and "unit"."rental_mode" is not null)
        or ("unit"."type" = 'room' and "unit"."rental_mode" is null and "unit"."occupies_whole_floor" = false)

unit_by_room_without_price.name: unit_by_room_without_price
unit_by_room_without_price.value: "unit"."rental_mode" is distinct from 'by_room' or "unit"."monthly_price" is null
